name: Taiiwo
biography: Taiiwo, a CicadaSolvers founding member, with a background in software development, sees the community's work as an example for the future of problem-solving. With a pragmatic, and sceptical approach to the puzzle, he aims to preserve the community so that it can continue to impact the lives of others as immensely as it did for him. Reddit: r/cicada
